'''February 2001 Worcester tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in That's Entertainment, Worcester, MA on 18 February 2001. [[Hayes Hunter]] won it. It is known from Hayes Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1752">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-20-worcester-ma-2-18-01d1752/ worcester-ma-2-18-01], DeckTech (Hayes "Hayes" Hunter, 20 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-20-worcester-ma-2-18-01d1752/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 February 2001
* '''Site:''' That's Entertainment, Worcester, MA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Hayes Hunter]]
